in_marathi.name: Rudraansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Rudra's tear
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudraansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rudraansh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rudra', which refers to Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and regeneration. The name Rudraansh signifies a tear shed by Lord Rudra, symbolizing compassion and power. This name is believed to bring strength and resilience to the bearer.
